title: Roast aubergine and runner bean bulgur bowls

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a whole food or a simple staple such as bulgur, tahini and feta, with no jars, stock pots or packet mixes.

supermarket.reason: Aubergines, runner beans, bulgur, tahini, Greek yoghurt and feta are all everyday Tesco lines at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a saucepan, a sieve and a grater, and uses simple roasting and boiling.

works.reason: Two aubergines, 200g bulgur, 300g beans and 100g feta make a sensible lunch for four, and the oven temperature, timings and boil-and-drain bulgur are all clear.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers cubing the aubergines, stringing and slicing the beans, grating the garlic and making the dressing, and the 25-minute roast matches the cook time with the bulgur done alongside.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the cumin, lemon, mint and pepper (covered by 'Season'), is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm-roasted aubergine bowl with runner beans and cherry tomatoes suits early July, and the aubergine is clearly the centre of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling mix of wholegrain, vegetables, yoghurt and feta that a family would happily eat again.
